leave.title: Staff leave
leave.lead: Ask for leave and follow your requests. Days are counted on the days the clinic is open.
leave.requests_lead: Approve or reject leave requests, and record leave for a staff member.
leave.calendar_lead: Who is on leave, day by day.
leave.ask_sub: Your request goes to the clinic manager for approval.
leave.record_sub: For a staff member. It is approved at once.
leave.cancel_confirm: Cancel this leave? The days go back to the balance.
leave.open_days_note: Leave days are counted on the days the clinic is open: {days}.
leave.all_days_note: The clinic has not set its working days yet, so every day of the week is counted.
leave.balance_help: Left this year: annual {annual} days, sick {sick} days.
leave.allowance_sub: Every staff member: {annual} annual days and {sick} sick days a year.
leave.allowance_help: The number of days each staff member may take every year. A staff member can have their own allowance.
leave.own_allowance_help: Leave empty to use the clinic's allowance ({annual} annual, {sick} sick).
leave.empty_mine_text: Use "Ask for leave" to send your first request.
leave.empty_list_text: No leave requests match these filters.
leave.payroll_deduct_help: Adds a deduction of the base salary ÷ 30 × the unpaid leave days. You can remove it before paying.
leave.payroll_deduct_done: A deduction for {n} unpaid leave days was added.

errors_leave.LEAVE_OVERLAP: There is already a leave request in these dates.
errors_leave.LEAVE_BALANCE: Not enough leave days left this year.

errors_leave.LEAVE_NOT_MEMBER: Your account is not an active staff member of this clinic.

errors_leave.LEAVE_DEDUCTION_EXISTS: The unpaid leave of this month is already deducted.
